purpose: Define a provider/model/surface-aware executor registry and quota/resource routing model that minimizes scarce frontier allowance while preserving capability, authority, privacy, context and validation requirements.
invariants: Executor selection never grants action authority.
Model identity alone is insufficient; execution surface/harness/toolset are part of executor identity.
Importance alone never forces a stronger reasoning tier.
TOO_LARGE and INTRINSICALLY_DIFFICULT are distinct routing outcomes.
Waiting for external events consumes no reasoning executor.
Unknown quota state does not become fabricated capacity.
A lower-cost executor may be selected only if required capabilities/context/privacy/authority constraints are satisfied.
Repeated lower-tier failures require evidence-based retry/decompose/escalate decisions rather than unlimited retry.
Usage accounting is durable and attributable to program/workstream/process/action.
Provider-specific quota mechanics are adapter data, not hard-coded scheduler semantics.

executor_identity.rationale: The same nominal model can behave materially differently through different harnesses, context managers, tools, permission surfaces and orchestration loops.

capability_profile.evidence_rule: Capabilities should be supported by benchmark/tool evidence where material. Unobserved capability may remain UNKNOWN rather than assumed.

classification_rules.TOO_LARGE: Node exceeds bounded context/action envelope but can be decomposed without losing the essential integrated decision.
classification_rules.INTRINSICALLY_DIFFICULT: After reasonable decomposition, the residual still requires stronger integrated reasoning or repeatedly fails objective review.
classification_rules.HUMAN_JUDGMENT: Owning contract makes a substantive human choice authoritative or evidence cannot mechanically settle the decision.

context_requirement.default_rule: Full conversation history is false by default for resumable processes; use durable semantic state and retrieve raw evidence only as needed.

usage_pool.unknown_rule: When the system cannot observe a quota exactly, record UNKNOWN or a conservative estimate; never synthesize exact remaining allowance.

usage_record.purpose: Measure verified progress per unit of scarce resource and calibrate future routing.

routing_algorithm: Reject routing if action authority is not ALLOW or if this is reasoning-only work whose contract forbids execution side effects.
Filter executors by exact required tool/capability/surface constraints.
Filter by context capacity and privacy/locality constraints.
Filter unavailable/exhausted resources; preserve UNKNOWN quota state explicitly.
If no executor fits because node is TOO_LARGE, return DECOMPOSE rather than stronger-model escalation.
Estimate success likelihood from benchmark evidence for the task/capability class.
Estimate scarce-resource impact across independent usage pools.
Select the lowest-scarcity eligible executor whose estimated success satisfies the task's confidence/validation policy.
After a failed attempt, classify failure as transient, implementation/tool, context/size, capability/reasoning, authority, or invalid validator.
Retry transient failures within bounded policy; repair tool/implementation failures if objectively diagnosable.
Escalate capability/reasoning failures only when lower-tier evidence supports INTRINSICALLY_DIFFICULT.
Persist RoutingDecision with candidates considered, exclusions, selected executor, pool snapshot, and rationale.

scarcity_objective.primary: maximize expected verified progress per unit of scarce renewable frontier allowance
secondary: avoid paid API use when an included/local executor is sufficient
avoid human attention for mechanically resolvable work
protect scarce frontier pools for intrinsically difficult residuals
use deterministic compute for deterministic work
scarcity_objective.non_objective: Do not minimize model cost by accepting materially lower validated output quality.

retry_categories.TOOL_OR_IMPLEMENTATION: diagnose/repair if objective failure evidence exists
retry_categories.VALIDATOR_OR_SPEC: repair benchmark/spec rather than blame executor

anti_loop: same unchanged reasoning node cannot be retried indefinitely
every retry records new evidence or changed premise
repeated no-progress attempts trigger decomposition or escalation
external waits never trigger reasoning retries

instant.role: default low-scarcity semantic/coding worker where benchmark evidence supports the capability

local_model.role: machine-triggerable extraction, triage, summarization, classification, retrieval/reranking, bounded reasoning where calibrated

subscription_agent.role: independent included allowance pool when interface/terms and capability justify use

human.role: authoritative substantive judgment or external consequence approval when required

benchmark_requirements: Calibrate Instant success by capability class rather than one global score.
Record executor surface/harness in every benchmark result.
Measure frontier escalations and avoided frontier calls.
Measure context packet size and repeated work after resume.
Include false escalation and unsafe under-escalation metrics.
Test provider unavailable while another compatible executor is available.
Test same model through two surfaces as distinct executors.
Test external WAIT with zero model polling.
